| `--layout-drawer-width` | `100%` | R | Width of a cart / menu / filter drawer, set on a panel anchored to the viewport edge. Tier: below 600px it is a full-width sheet (a 26rem cap alone is already full width up to 416px but leaves a 1 to 44px sliver of page between 417 and 460px, 12px at 430px, and a fixed 44px peek strip is an undiscoverable dismiss target); from 600px a 26rem side panel (416px, always leaving page visible). The sheet needs a visible close button, a scrolling body and a visible primary action (all present in the dashboard specimen); Escape, focus trap and focus return are JavaScript, not yet built |
| `--grid-columns-products` | `2` | R | Collection / search product grid. Tier: 2 columns on phones give a card 136px wide at 320px, 156px at 360px and 171px at 390px (16px gutter and gap); 3 and 4 follow as width allows. Other page grids are decided in the wireframe phase |

## Scope `.surface-inverse` (from `semantic.json` `$scopes`)

Apply the class to any element to re-map the semantic tokens below for everything inside it. Tokens that alias an overridden token are re-declared automatically (listed under Re-declared), because custom-property aliases resolve where they are declared. Form controls get a transparent background, light text and a light border; test them on the real surface.

**Overrides**

- `background: var(--color-bg-inverse)`
- `color: var(--color-text-inverse)`
- `--color-bg-page: var(--color-bg-inverse)`
- `--color-text-primary: var(--color-text-inverse)`
- `--color-text-secondary: var(--color-text-inverse-secondary)`
- `--color-text-muted: var(--palette-neutral-300)`
- `--color-border-subtle: var(--color-border-inverse-subtle)`
- `--color-border-strong: var(--color-border-inverse)`
- `--color-link: var(--color-link-inverse)`
- `--color-link-hover: var(--color-link-inverse-hover)`
- `--color-focus-ring: var(--color-focus-ring-inverse)`
- `--color-control-bg: transparent`
- `--color-button-secondary-text-hover: var(--color-bg-inverse)`

**Re-declared (generated):** `--color-button-secondary-border`, `--color-button-secondary-bg-hover`, `--color-control-border`, `--color-control-border-hover`, `--color-rating-star-empty`, `--focus-ring`
